name: com.bently.somnisync
description: Server-authoritative real-time physics networking for Unity VR worlds. Pairs with the SomniSync Rust relay server (Rapier3D physics, 50 Hz sim / 20 Hz broadcast, per-client area-of-interest filtering).

samples.description: A preconfigured scene with NetworkManager, a player rig, a grabbable cube, an NPC with wander, and a spawn hotkey. Import, open QuickStart.unity, press Play.
